builder.description: Arrange modules and lectures, add problems, and control what students can see.
builder.unavailable_body: It belongs to another academy, or your membership cannot open it.
builder.load_failed_body: This is not a permissions problem. Something went wrong on the server — try again, and check the server logs if it persists.
builder.structural_error: Could not save that change. Try again.
builder.not_teachable_body: The course is visible, but no problems inside it are. Choose “Show all content” to make it teachable.
builder.not_teachable_body_readonly: The course is visible, but no problems inside it are. Ask a Team Lead to show its content.

empty.heading: Start with a module
empty.body: A module is a chunk of the course — “Loops”, “Functions”. Lectures live inside it, and exercises live inside lectures.

exercise.conflict: Changed in another session — reload before saving
exercise.save_failed_detail: The problem could not be saved. Check the required fields and try again.
exercise.unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
exercise.basic_help: Set the problem title, difficulty, description, and input/output requirements.
exercise.code_help: Optional code students see when they first open the problem.
exercise.solution_code_help: Required correct Python solution. Only authorized problem authors and a teacher actively monitoring the assigned student can view it.

field.title: Problem title
field.ai_feedback_hint: For now, this saves whether AI feedback is enabled for the problem.
field.is_visible_hint: Turn this off to hide only this problem. Its content remains editable.

placeholder.title: e.g. Sum two numbers
placeholder.description: Explain the task, examples, and important details.
placeholder.input_format: e.g. The first line contains an integer N.
placeholder.output_format: e.g. Print the sum on a single line.

test.help: Choose which test cases students can see as examples and which stay hidden for grading. A problem without test cases can be saved, but students cannot attempt it.
test.label: Test case {{number}}

hint.empty: Hints are optional. Add one when a learner may need a gentle nudge.
hint.help: Hints are optional and appear in the order shown here.
hint.label: Hint {{number}}

exercise.preview_student_note: This is what students see. Only sample test cases and hints appear here.
exercise.preview_hidden_count_one: {{count}} hidden grading case is not shown to students.
exercise.preview_hidden_count_other: {{count}} hidden grading cases are not shown to students.

error.title: Enter a problem title.
error.test: Add at least one sample test case that students can see.

exercise.no_tests_note: No test cases yet, so students cannot attempt this problem. You can save it now and add test cases later.

row.hidden_by_parent_tooltip: Set to visible, but hidden because a parent is hidden

visibility_confirm.title: Hide this {{kind}}?
visibility_confirm.description: Review what students will lose access to before hiding it.
visibility_confirm.student_impact: Students will no longer see or open this content.
visibility_confirm.preserved: Visibility choices inside it stay saved. Showing this item again restores the previous visibility of its content.

move.body: Choose where it should sit among the others.
move.step_lecture: Which lecture should it go to?
move.step_module: Which chapter should it go to?
move.unchanged: That is where it is now. Choose where to move it.
move.will_hide: Students will no longer see it: “{{hiddenBy}}” is hidden.
move.will_show: Students will be able to see it after the move.
move.history_kept: Students' submissions and progress are kept.
move.undo_unavailable: Can't undo: the original place no longer exists.

pdf.description: Upload one PDF and choose where students can find it. New materials start hidden.
pdf.title: Title
pdf.choose: Choose a PDF or drop it here

errors.PDF_TOO_LARGE: Choose a PDF no larger than 95 MB.
errors.PDF_INVALID: Choose a valid PDF without a password.
errors.PDF_BUSY: PDF validation is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.PDF_STORAGE_FAILED: Could not store the PDF. Try again.
errors.PDF_UPLOAD_EXPIRED: Upload the file again before saving.
errors.PDF_EDIT_STALE: The material changed. Reload before editing.
errors.PDF_VALIDATION_LIMIT: The PDF exceeds the processing limit.
errors.PDF_REFERENCE_INVALID: Choose a supplementary PDF in the same lecture for this Python exercise.
errors.PDF_REFERENCE_IN_USE: This PDF is linked to coding exercises. Detach or change their reference PDFs before moving, deleting, or changing its placement.
errors.PDF_REFERENCE_NOT_READY: Publish the reference PDF and its parents before publishing this exercise.

pdf.replacement_notice: Students see replacements on their next load.
